metadata.title: New-SubredditHTMLArchive
metadata.description: Windows turnkey wrapper for BDFR and BDFR-HTML Python modules. Installs modules, and prerequisites, then creates offline/portable HTML archives of subreddit posts and comments.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.
